celebrates: Prior Lake gathers at Lakefront Park for DecemBRRR Dazzle, the city's tree lighting night. The ceremony is followed by fireworks over the park, and families can visit Santa at the pavilion, watch ice carving demonstrations and warm up by a giant bonfire. The City of Prior Lake hosts it and asks guests to check its weather page in bad conditions.
lastyear: The 2026 event is the second annual DecemBRRR Dazzle, according to the city calendar, so the first one ran in 2025. A City of Prior Lake Facebook video promoted that earlier event with the park's amphitheater tree. The city has used the same pavilion, ice carving and bonfire setup in its listings.
facts: DecemBRRR Dazzle is only in its second year. It takes place at Lakefront Park, 5000 Kop Parkway SE. Snacks and refreshments are sold at the event.
